_about: W-analysis store: one record per 2025 federal polling place keyed to the four SEIFA 2021 indexes (irsd/irsad/ier/ieo scores + ABS-published national deciles) via the SA1 polygon containing the booth's premises coordinates. The SA1 is the SA1 OF THE PREMISES — a geographic proxy for the catchment's SES, not an aggregate of catchment voters; SEIFA is area-derived, cross-time comparisons are rank/decile only, and the 2021 census vintage leads the 2025 election by ~3.7 years. Coordinate-less mobile/hospital teams carry note=noCoords; rows with (0,0) AEC coordinates carry note=badCoords unless a corrected coordinate is on file (see _provenance.userOverrides); SA1s score-suppressed in the cube carry note=seifaSuppressed with seifa:null. stateFlag is only a guard report (premises state vs SA1 state); the physical premises location wins.
